stories.label: Iran-US nuclear standoff and military buildup
stories.summary: Talks stalled. Pentagon assembles largest Middle East strike force since 2003 — two carriers, F-35s, F-22s, EW aircraft. Trump sets public 10-day deadline. Sweden and Poland evacuating citizens. White House source says 90% chance of attack. Iran says enrichment is its right. Hezbollah vows to defend Iran.

stories.label: South Korea Yoon martial law verdict
stories.summary: Yoon sentenced to life imprisonment for imposing martial law. Prosecutors had sought death penalty. South Korea hasn't executed since 1997. Appeal expected. President Lee now presiding over political realignment.

stories.label: Sudan genocide assessment and humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: UN fact-finding mission crosses critical threshold: 'hallmarks of genocide' in RSF's capture of El-Fasher. Coordinated 18-month siege targeting non-Arab communities. At least 15 children killed in drone strike on displacement camp this week. International community still failing to act.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Talks stalled. Zelensky dismissed Putin's 'historical' claims as delay tactics. No new round announced. Focus has shifted to Iran crisis.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and Hezbollah disarmament
stories.summary: Hezbollah rejected disarmament timeline. Now vowing to defend Iran in potential US conflict. Lebanon braces for spillover from Iran-US confrontation.

stories.label: Trump Board of Peace for Gaza
stories.summary: First meeting held Feb 19. $7bn pledged by member nations, US committed $10bn more. Five countries committed troops for international stabilization force. 47 participating countries. Indonesia offering troops — first Muslim-majority non-Arab nation. Trump outlined 10-year vision. Palestinians deeply skeptical. Not re-selected as standalone — Iran escalation captured today's key development.

stories.label: European defence autonomy push
stories.summary: Faltering fighter jet deal casts doubt on EU defence plans. German chancellor signaled preference for US jets. Ongoing but no breakthrough development.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: AI Impact Summit in Delhi. Altman calls for urgent global regulation. Next summit to be in Geneva. Gemini 3.1 Pro released. Macron pitches 'technology with humanity' vision. Not independently selected this cycle.

stories.label: Iran anti-regime protest movement
stories.summary: Protest movement continuing but overshadowed by US military buildup and strike threat. Internal Iranian dynamics secondary to external confrontation.

stories.label: Ocalan announces PKK dissolution
stories.summary: Parliamentary commission report adopted. Reintegration gaining momentum. Turkish journalist arrested for social media posts — press freedom dimension. Not selected this cycle.

stories.label: Russia gives FSB internet shutdown authority
stories.summary: FSB digital control expansion. Teachers in 10 regions face payment delays amid budget strain. Russia urging restraint on Iran while pitching $14T US-Russia projects.

stories.label: Trump hints at Taiwan weapons decision
stories.summary: US sending weapons to Philippines. Indo-Pacific security tensions remain elevated but attention shifted to Iran crisis.

stories.label: US strikes on alleged drug-trafficking boats
stories.summary: At least 145 killed. US Southern Command leader visited Venezuela, met new interim leaders after Maduro capture. Story developing but not independently selected.

stories.label: Peru political instability (Chifagate)
stories.summary: Eighth president since 2016. Jose Maria Balcazar installed as interim president. Not selected but worth watching for stability.

stories.label: Canada launches defence overhaul
stories.summary: Carney defence plan. No new development. Connects to broader NATO autonomy theme.

stories.label: EU regulatory crackdown on tech platforms
stories.summary: Comesa now probing Meta for locking rival chatbots out of WhatsApp — African antitrust dimension. Grok privacy abuses continue. Not selected independently.

stories.summary: No new development.

stories.summary: No new development.

stories.label: UK unemployment hits 5-year high
stories.summary: No new development. Mandelson lobbying firm on brink of collapse — related UK economy signal.

stories.label: Japan's Takaichi reappointed as PM
stories.summary: Takaichi governing. Japan approved world's first iPS cell medicines (separate story). Russia-Japan island dispute still unresolved after 80 years. Not re-selected as standalone.

stories.label: Zuckerberg social media addiction trial
stories.summary: Trial ongoing. Zuckerberg grilled on usage goals and underage users. Connects to broader platform accountability push. Not re-selected as no major new development beyond last cycle.

stories.label: Climate change threatens coffee regions
stories.summary: Study on arabica growing regions becoming unsuitable. No follow-up.

stories.label: FDA approves pancreatic cancer device
stories.summary: Novocure device approved. No follow-up.

stories.label: Pakistan Punjab police extrajudicial killings
stories.summary: Karachi building collapse killed 15+ in separate event. Pakistan-US signed Roosevelt Hotel redevelopment pact. Punjab killings story not followed up independently.

stories.label: Rubio-Castro grandson backchannel
stories.summary: No new development. Cuba energy crisis continues.

stories.label: NATO-China tech and military decoupling
stories.summary: China's Zeekr launching EV sales in France — commercial entry while military decoupling. No follow-up.

stories.label: North Korea ninth Workers' Party congress
stories.summary: Ninth congress opened Feb 19. Previous congresses in 2021 and 2016. Rare event that typically signals major policy shifts. Watch for nuclear posture, economic direction, leadership changes.

stories.label: Former Prince Andrew arrested over Epstein links
stories.summary: First British royal arrested in modern history. Detained on suspicion of misconduct in public office — passing confidential government documents to Epstein as trade envoy. Released under investigation after 11 hours. King Charles: 'law must take its course.'

stories.label: US trade deficit hits record despite tariffs
stories.summary: 2025 trade deficit widened to record — first full year of Trump tariff campaign. Imports surged as businesses front-loaded purchases. Directly undercuts central economic rationale of trade war.

stories.label: Japan approves first iPS cell commercial therapies
stories.summary: World's first commercial iPS cell products approved. Two regenerative medicines including ReHeart for heart failure. Landmark for field that won Yamanaka the 2012 Nobel Prize.

stories.label: Cat cancer genome reveals shared human mutations
stories.summary: International team mapped mutations driving aggressive cancer in both cats and humans. Shared pathways could accelerate treatment development for both species.

stories.label: Microsoft Copilot exposed confidential emails
stories.summary: Misconfiguration exposed confidential internal emails to Copilot users. Microsoft says error not design flaw. Highlights systemic risk of enterprise AI tools with broad data access.

stories.label: IRS loses 40% of IT staff in efficiency drive
stories.summary: 40% of IT workforce and 80% of tech leadership gone. Processes hundreds of millions of tax returns, manages trillions in revenue. Raises concerns about tax season processing and cybersecurity.

stories.label: Philippines-China South China Sea tensions
stories.summary: US sending weapons to Philippines. Attention shifted to Iran. Fading as standalone.
